title: 機械要素設計
subtitle: Mechanical Elements Design
teachers:
KISHI Yoichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	Understand the mechanical elements.
(2)	Learn the method of machine design.
(3)	Practice the design of a screw, shaft, and gear.
advice:
This is a course on the basics of machine design. We will cover the following topics:

1. Basics of design:
  (1) procedure of the design, (2) design and processing, and (3) reliability design
2. Strength and stiffness of materials:
  (1) load and material properties, (2) fatigue strength and deformation stress, and (3) detailed design and safety factor
3. Mechanical elements:
  (1) screws, (2) shafts and bearings, and (3) gears

Students should strive to improve their design ability.
books:
Textbooks: Methods of Machine Design, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese)
Reference books: JIS Mechanical Drawing, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese)
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
Complete Mechanical Drawing I and II, Engineering Mechanics, and Strength of Materials I.
Know how to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the design process.
Be able to explain engineering ethics, design for reliability, and safety factors.
Be able to design for strength.
Be able to perform calculations necessary for screw, shaft and bearing, and design them.
Be able to perform calculations necessary for gear, and design it.
Be able to choose appropriate part dimensions and shapes with reference to various standards

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand design solutions and explain the design process clearly.
(2) Extensively understand safety factors and have the ethical perspective of an engineer.
(3) Confidently select the dimensions and shape of a material based on a standard.
(4) Confidently select screw and shaft diameters based on a dynamic calculation.
(5) Calculate the gear dimensions and number of teeth using the speed transmission ratio and module.
(6) Understand the ethics information taught by a local engineer.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand design solutions and explain the design process.
(2) Understand safety factors and have the ethical perspective of an engineer.
(3) Select the dimensions and shape of a material based on a standard.
(4) Select screw and shaft diameters based on a dynamic calculation.
(5) Calculate the number of gear teeth using the speed transmission ratio and module.
(6) Understand the information provided by a local engineer.
